description: This file sets up and starts an Express server, specifying listen port and host, handling shutdown signals, and exporting the server instance.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the Express server listening on the specified port and host.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for process signals, specifically handling SIGTERM for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections and executes a callback upon completion.

methods.name: console.log
methods.description: Outputs log messages to the console.

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the process with a specified code, signaling termination.
